So: a real, oversized, multi-leg counter rally in week 1 into week 2, then the model stream cuts the back end (0125 -2.315 for Jan 30; 0129 fwd7 floor 26.079) and the bounce dies into a chain-sided sell of the bullish 0129 print. NET: near-flat-to-marginally-negative block with a large mid-block up-excursion fully retraced. NO FLIP CALLED, NO BLEED-END CALLED.
